menu.pin: Widget right-click menu item. The widget leaves the board and floats in its own window above every other app until released. Same idea as Windows' "Always on top". 2 to 4 words, no full stop.
menu.unpin: Right-click menu item of a widget that is kept on top (menu.pin). The window closes and the widget returns to its spot on the board. 2 to 3 words, no full stop.
menu.more: Tooltip and screen-reader name of the ⋯ button at the right end of a widget title bar. It opens the same menu as right-clicking the widget. 1 to 2 words.
demo.unavailable: Toast in the tutorial demo, shown when the user picks a tray menu item the demo does not run (Library, Settings, Language and so on). It tells them the item works in the real app. A short phrase, no full stop in English.
demo.tray_icon: Accessible name and tooltip of the fake tray icon on the demo's fake taskbar. It stands for the real WidgetBoard tray icon; keep the product name as the app uses it. 3 to 5 words.
demo.sample.ev_today: Title of a sample calendar entry dated today on the tutorial demo's sample board. A short, everyday event name, 1 to 3 words, no full stop.
demo.sample.ev_later: Title of a sample calendar entry two days from today on the demo's sample board. A short, everyday event name, 1 to 3 words, no full stop.
demo.sample.todo_1: Sample checklist item on the demo board, shown as already done. A short everyday chore, no full stop.
demo.sample.todo_2: Sample checklist item on the demo board, not yet done. A short everyday chore, no full stop.
demo.sample.todo_3: Sample checklist item on the demo board, not yet done. A short everyday chore, no full stop.
demo.sample.dd_exam: Name of a sample D-day countdown (a date ahead) on the demo board. One word, a neutral event.
demo.sample.dd_birthday: Name of a sample yearly D-day (counts down to the next one) on the demo board. One word.
demo.sample.memo: Text of a sample memo on the demo board. The memo starts hidden, so the user sees it only if they show it. 2 to 3 words, no full stop.
demo.sample.track: Label of the sample audio file in Now Playing's My files list on the demo board. A neutral 2-word title for a few soft tones, no full stop.
demo.sample.song: Title of the pretend track that Windows is playing on the demo board's Now Playing widget. A neutral song-like title, 2 to 3 words, no full stop.
demo.sample.artist: Artist name of the pretend track on the demo board's Now Playing widget. It must read as an obvious placeholder, 2 words.
tut.title: Tutorial demo: title instruction or control label.
tut.next: Tutorial demo: next instruction or control label.
tut.back: Tutorial demo: button that returns to the previous step.
tut.skip: Tutorial demo: skip instruction or control label.
tut.finish: Tutorial demo: finish instruction or control label.
tut.t1.tray: Tutorial demo: tray instruction or control label.
tut.t1.edit: Tutorial demo: edit instruction or control label.
tut.t1.grid: Tutorial demo: grid instruction or control label.
tut.t1.move: Tutorial demo: move instruction or control label.
tut.t1.resize: Tutorial demo: resize instruction or control label.
tut.t1.push: Tutorial demo: push instruction or control label.
tut.t1.menu: Tutorial demo: menu instruction or control label.
tut.t1.add: Tutorial demo: add instruction or control label.
tut.t1.done: Tutorial demo: done instruction or control label.
tut.t1.end: Tutorial demo: end instruction or control label.
tut.welcome: First-run invitation to try the practice demo before selecting a preset.
tut.try: Button to open the practice demo.
help.got_it: Button that dismisses a one-time contextual help card.
help.guide_pin: Accessible label and tooltip for a small question-mark pin attached to a newly added widget. It opens that widget type in Settings Guide.
lay.sample.deadline: Title of a sample D-day countdown (14 days out) added the first time the user applies the Work desk layout. The user keeps or deletes it. 1 to 3 words, no full stop.
lay.sample.report: Sample to-do added with the Work desk layout. A short everyday work task, no full stop.
lay.sample.slides: Sample to-do added with the Work desk layout. A short everyday work task, no full stop.
lay.sample.meeting: Title of a sample calendar entry (tomorrow 10:00) added with the Work desk layout. 1 to 3 words, no full stop.
lay.sample.exam: Title of a sample D-day countdown (30 days out) added the first time the user applies the Study layout. 1 to 3 words, no full stop.
lay.sample.words: Sample to-do added with the Study layout. A short study task, no full stop.
lay.sample.workbook: Sample to-do added with the Study layout. A short study task, no full stop.
lay.sample.debut: Title of a sample D-day added with the Oshi layout. It counts up from a date one year ago (the idol's debut), with 100-day milestones. 1 to 3 words, no full stop.
look.theme: Small heading in the widget Look panel, above the two theme pickers. 1 word.
look.theme_widget: Label of the picker that sets a theme for this one widget only. 1 to 2 words.
look.theme_type: Label of the picker that sets a theme for every widget of this type. {name} is the widget type (Clock, Memo). Short.
look.theme_follow_type: First option of the this-widget picker: no own theme, use the one set for its type. Short.
look.theme_follow_board: First option of the all-of-this-type picker: no type theme, use the board's theme. Short.
